data_functions.name: existing_cancelled_refund
data_functions.description: 执行时从数据库查询真实已取消退票单，供取消接口幂等校验使用；不修改数据，不构造订单身份。

statement.value: SELECT refund_serial_no FROM saas_refund_order WHERE refund_state = 6 AND is_delete = 0 ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1

data_functions.name: existing_voucher_refund_by_state
data_functions.description: 执行时读取已有未删除代金券退票订单，按指定源码枚举状态筛选第一笔真实订单。代金券不触发CBDS取消；无匹配记录则准备失败而不构造身份。

statement.value: SELECT refund_serial_no, refund_state FROM saas_refund_order WHERE is_delete = 0 AND is_voucher = 1 ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1000

case_templates.title: 已取消订单再次取消返回成功

oracles.statement: SELECT refund_state FROM saas_refund_order WHERE refund_serial_no = :refund_serial_no LIMIT 1

case_templates.title: 代金券退票单从允许取消的五种状态取消成功

oracles.statement: SELECT refund_state FROM saas_refund_order WHERE refund_serial_no = :refund_serial_no LIMIT 1

case_templates.title: 退票中、退票成功和退款完成禁止取消且状态不变（已有代金券订单）
